# Getting help

Mools is a free, volunteer-run project. Here is where to go:

| I want to... | Go to |
| --- | --- |
| Learn how a tool works | The tool's page has a description, and the [wiki](https://github.com/maling-it/tools/wiki) explains the project |
| Report a bug | The [bug report form](https://github.com/maling-it/tools/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) |
| Ask for a new tool or feature | The [tool request form](https://github.com/maling-it/tools/issues/new?template=tool_request.yml) |
| Ask a question or give feedback | The [feedback form](https://github.com/maling-it/tools/issues/new?template=feedback.yml) |
| Report an accessibility barrier | The [accessibility form](https://github.com/maling-it/tools/issues/new?template=accessibility.yml) |
| Report a security problem | The [security policy](SECURITY.md) (privately, please) |
| Set up the MCP server for an AI agent | The [Agent Support](https://github.com/maling-it/tools/wiki/Agent-Support) wiki page and the MCP Config Generator tool on the site |
| Contribute code | [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) |

Before you open an issue, please search the [existing issues](https://github.com/maling-it/tools/issues) and check the [roadmap](https://github.com/orgs/maling-it/projects/3). We answer in the open on GitHub, so everyone can benefit.
